name: Mission Control · Federation Flight Deck
tagline: Build the evidence. Trace every decision. Ship only what is proven.

repositories.name: GBOGEB/pipeline-automation-hub
repositories.role: Orchestrate the mission; publish method and evidence projections
repositories.inputs: Root ownership, repo catalog, GitHub actions and SSOT references
repositories.outputs: Wave scorecards, dashboards, GOGREEN scout plans and atlas receipts
repositories.boundaries: Read-only federation projection; owner controls external

repositories.name: GBOGEB/ABACUS
repositories.role: Detect first-reds, measure attributed debt, test runtime and admission
repositories.inputs: CI event IDs, BD/LDAB signatures, tests, Security and coverage
repositories.outputs: Root-linked CI receipts, census and DOW compatibility evidence
repositories.boundaries: A10, protected ruleset and eligible review remain independent

repositories.name: GBOGEB/CODEX
repositories.role: Semantic execution, debugger bridges and source-bound consumer contracts
repositories.inputs: Provider graph, manifests, runtime and LLDB/Docker proof
repositories.outputs: KEB compatibility evidence, debugger receipts and lineage probes
repositories.boundaries: A fixture is not an authenticated cross-repository replay

repositories.name: GBOGEB/cryoplant-project
repositories.role: Engineering recipient; decide ACCEPT, REJECT or DEFER
repositories.inputs: Controlled engineering source, producer proposals and corporate document pointers
repositories.outputs: QPS acceptance gate, engineering render and adapter test evidence
repositories.boundaries: No engineering acceptance without recipient owner authority

repositories.name: GBOGEB/gg_MATH
repositories.inputs: Named models, assumptions, source hashes and numerical test baselines
repositories.outputs: Provider model graph and reproducible calculation receipts
repositories.boundaries: Model truth and engineering signoff are not implied by CI status

repositories.name: GBOGEB/DOCX_RTM_Automation
repositories.role: Requirement traceability and controlled document projections
repositories.inputs: Controlled data, RTM and corporate document-control references
repositories.outputs: DOCX / XLSX traceability views and QA receipts
repositories.boundaries: Generated Office files are not corporate approved originals

ci_contract.label: CI contract
ci_contract.next: Select a terminal exact-head run/job; bind required contexts, test population and first-red
ci_contract.proof: Terminal run + job + exact SHA + selected check context

security.label: Security
security.next: Locate native scan/report with scanner configuration and fail-closed classification
security.proof: Named scanner, policy/config, exact SHA and eligible review

coverage.label: Coverage
coverage.next: Acquire matched line/branch JSON, source digest, tool version and executed tests
coverage.proof: Native numerator, denominator and identical source scope

runtime.label: Runtime / debug
runtime.next: Find native Docker, RHEL, LLDB or MCP session receipt; record ports/image/tools
runtime.proof: Real session ID and execution outcome, not planned probe

artifact.label: Artifact bytes
artifact.next: Download producer ZIP, compare upload SHA256, verify member manifest and pinned source
artifact.proof: Independent bytes + artifact ID + run/job SHA

federation.label: Federation
federation.next: Join provider and consumer receipts by source identity; separate fixture from native
federation.proof: Cross-hop verified identity and eligible recipient disposition

qps_triage.label: QPS TRIAGE
qps_triage.next: Route candidate into recipient-controlled ACCEPT/REJECT/DEFER with engineering source
qps_triage.proof: Authenticated native child evidence and explicit engineering signoff

math_model.label: Math/model
math_model.next: Check numerical source graph, baseline tests and assumptions before adaptation
math_model.proof: Pinned source model and reproducible test results

pipeline.name: Choose controlled source
pipeline.gate: Reject drift, missing source and duplicate repo/family

pipeline.name: Build evidence census
pipeline.trigger: PR, GitHub workflow_dispatch or owner CLI
pipeline.outputs: census.json · BD leaf register · anchor details
pipeline.gate: 36 UNKNOWN remain UNKNOWN; null is not 0

pipeline.name: Join and triage first-reds
pipeline.trigger: Confirmed job RED and root fingerprint
pipeline.command: Consume read-only census + repo-local root receipts
pipeline.inputs: CI failure signature, Bandit/DAB findings, LLDB session
pipeline.outputs: BD links, accountable next test, root ID if proven
pipeline.gate: No issue count as proof of root closure

pipeline.name: Compose user navigation
pipeline.inputs: Validated census, method registry and stages

pipeline.name: Render Office / PDF
pipeline.trigger: After source validation, optional binary toolchain
pipeline.inputs: Current SSOT census + corporate reference placeholders
pipeline.gate: No invented ALX/SCK CEN doc number or corporate approval

pipeline.name: Compare files and testflight
pipeline.command: python -m unittest test_flightdeck.py; python flightdeck.py verify --out <dir>
pipeline.inputs: Files, same-source digest, counts, browser checks
pipeline.gate: Exact-head native CI separate from local reproducibility

pipeline.name: Publish only on admitted main
pipeline.command: GitHub Actions deploy artifact after required status and review
pipeline.inputs: Verified committed SHA, no critical RED, legal review
pipeline.outputs: Versioned hosted GitHub Pages read-only site
pipeline.gate: Owner Pages enabling; branch protection; no PR-write token

pipeline.name: Review next wave and recensus
pipeline.trigger: New native evidence, dependency change or recertification time
pipeline.command: Append observed pulse and regenerate projections
pipeline.inputs: Exact-main terminal runs, roots, deltas, receipts
pipeline.outputs: M1/M2/M3 states, control charts only with comparable data

wave_definitions.name: Traceable source inventory
wave_definitions.victory: 42/42 typed leaves, 36 explicit unknown work orders, 5/5 current-main anchors classified, all 6 repo identities linked

wave_definitions.name: User flight deck and deterministic artifacts
wave_definitions.victory: CLI preflight/build/verify; filterable HTML, SVG, JSON, Markdown and optional Office/PDF with parity checks

wave_definitions.name: Native protected publication
wave_definitions.victory: Exact-head tests, guarded integration, exact-main artifact and Pages readback with matching source hash

controls.name: Source scope lock
controls.threshold: 42/42 typed cells and 6 unique repository identities
controls.response: FAIL build on schema, duplicates, denominator drift

controls.name: Missing evidence transparency
controls.threshold: 36/36 UNKNOWN with unique leaf IDs and BD links
controls.response: Never turn UNKNOWN into FAIL or PASS

controls.name: Preflight and tests
controls.threshold: 100% deterministic validations pass, no zero-test accepted
controls.response: Stop at first invalid source or orphan link

controls.name: Coverage ramp
controls.threshold: Local focused generator target ≥85% lines and ≥75% branches; never compare unmatched files
controls.response: HOLD native coverage credit pending actual producer receipt

controls.name: Output parity
controls.threshold: HTML/JSON/MD/XLSX/PPTX/DOCX/PDF carry same source SHA and 6/42 census
controls.response: Regenerate all projections; no direct binary source editing

controls.name: Admission and privacy
controls.threshold: No critical red; eligible review; required statuses and confidentiality approval
controls.response: HOLD/DEFER, never force merge from renderer

controls.name: Publication confidence
controls.threshold: Source PR merged, main exact-head native success, Pages URL content hash readback
controls.response: Mark hosted state UNKNOWN until verified

controls.name: Statistical eligibility
controls.threshold: M1 source/denom valid; M2 repeated independent time observations; M3 capability limits; PCA numeric vectors; BT observed pairs
controls.response: Modeling HOLD; no invented confidence intervals
